title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Application Modernization Platform (“AMP”) is a MongoDB offering that modernises our customer’s legacy relational applications to a modern architecture underpinned by MongoDB using a combination of software, processes, and engineers. In this offering, the people and software are inextricably linked and cannot be separated. The delivery happens in an accelerated timeframe wherein the team takes advantage of GenAI and algorithmic tooling to expedite the turnaround time for application delivery.  

AMP team generally works with enterprise-grade customers, in all verticals on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, addresses multiple customer-facing opportunities. The role also becomes the forefront of groundbreaking R&D that enables further acceleration for enterprises working across a variety of technologies.

AMP exists to expedite time to value for customers who are looking forward to changing, modernising and updating their tech stack while keeping MongoDB the cornerstone of their system architecture.

As the Senior Technical Project Manager, you will work in conjunction with the team’s Technical Lead to lead a small Agile team responsible for migrating a customer’s legacy Java application to a modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB. The team will use the latest genAI tools and approaches to accelerate the migration process. You will also be responsible for liaising with customers and internal stakeholders, managing concerns and potential resolutions, and guiding the team towards success. The Agile team will be required to be innovative in deriving solutions to unseen challenges, and you will foster a culture of innovation and collaboration within the team. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Germany for our hybrid working model.

Position Expectations

  • Agile mindset with an understanding of SCRUM/Kanban processes
  • Able to support a project team consisting of onsite, co-located and remote team members
  • Be able to proactively identify and remove impediments
  • Manage project risks and issues
  • Define and refine project team’s “Way of Working”
  • Streamline communications between the project team and project stakeholders
  • Able to manage expectations of project stakeholders, where the majority are leaders within the organization
  • Operate in a small, dynamic, fast-growing team, able to be self-sufficient with an ability to have a can-do attitude and make oneself accountable
  • Act as a liaison between the customer, project team and the rest of MongoDB (sales, customer success, support, product and engineering) throughout an engagement
  • Create plans and priorities for both project delivery and customer resources. Guide customer as well as project team members to a successful business outcome by managing the client relationship and setting and managing customer expectations during implementations 
  • Establish and lead recurring project status or governance meetings, including preparation of materials and working with customer project manager and key internal and external stakeholders to review key project information and maintain visibility and accountability
  • Periodically report, in a concise and actionable manner, project status both internally as well as to the customer and document project progress as per established best practices (meeting minutes, project plan updates, weekly status reports)
  • Manage escalations or critical situation
  • Assist with scoping of solution and project scope definition
  • Adopt a consultative and prescriptive approach that inspires trust and confidence
  • Be intrigued by the possibilities of genAI to assist in accelerating the delivery of projects

Requirements

  • 10+ years of project management experience with enterprise-scale software solutions, large-scale software engineering or consulting services delivery experience preferred
  • Excellent customer interaction and presentation skills (ability to present to different audiences and bring the message across in a concise, professional manner) 
  • Demonstrated belief in the power of stakeholder management and communications; track record of affecting change through stakeholder engagement
  • Services delivery experience with development or operation teams is a plus
  • Ability to travel and work on customer sites for a number of continuous weeks

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience as a SCRUM master
  • Experience in managing projects with a high degree of uncertainty (research and innovation)
  • Experience in delivering software development projects (ideally modernization of a legacy application)
  • Experience with JIRA / Project tools

Successful candidates will engage with customer systems and may be exposed to highly confidential customer data, including but not limited to non-public information. For this reason, and due to the nature of the highly regulated industry in which our customers operate, successful candidates may be subject to enhanced background checks, security screenings, and possible constraints around the trading of securities. Successful candidates will understand these requirements and be willing to participate in enhanced screenings and constraints as required by MongoDB and its customers in connection with this role. 

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: About Agent F Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention. Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control. We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work. About the role You will sit exactly where sales, customer success and engineering meet. When a larger customer signs, you make sure they get precisely the product they need, and that it goes live. You understand their finance and operations setup, configure and extend Agent F for it, drive the data migration and the integrations, run the project to go-live and stay until the expansion works. This is operational work inside customer projects. You will be the technical counterpart for the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams, the person who knows what was promised and what is possible, and the one who brings back to engineering (as clear, prioritised requirements) whatever cannot be solved on site. On key accounts the CEO is in the room and the whole team pulls through together. Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means time to live and the ARR of the accounts you bring live. What you will build and own Implementation projects. Own scope, plan and delivery from kick-off to verified go-live for your accounts: stakeholders, timeline, risks, decisions. Migration and integration. Map the customer’s data, run the imports, reconcile totals against the source and connect Agent F to the systems the customer keeps. Verify the result with the customer before go-live. Configuration and extension. Workflows, rules, automations and custom logic on the platform, set up for the customer’s way of working. Customer-facing technical lead. Run the technical workstreams with the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams; document decisions and keep everyone informed. Product feedback. Turn what customers need into specified, prioritised requirements for engineering; validate delivered features with the customer. Expansion readiness. Identify and prepare the next step in each account (the next entity, module or process) together with the account owner. FDE economics. Track the hours you deliver per account against what was sold and keep delivery inside the agreed effort. For example, a corporate subsidiary signs with a go-live date tied to its next month-end. You would scope the migration, map and import the history, reconcile it with the customer’s controller, configure the approval workflows, connect the bank feed, and run the first close with them (inside the SLA) while logging the two product gaps you found as clear requirements for engineering. What you bring You have five or more years in technical implementation, solutions consulting or IT project management for business software (ERP, accounting, finance or operations systems) with real customer projects behind you. You are hands-on with data, mappings, configuration and integrations and comfortable reconciling a migration yourself. You do not need to be a software engineer. You can walk us through an implementation you ran: what the customer needed, what went wrong, how you got to go-live and what you would do differently. You are calm with customers, precise with engineers and stubborn about go-live. Core experience Implementation or technical project management of ERP, accounting, finance or operations software with corporate or Mittelstand customers. Data migration: mapping, import, reconciliation against the source, validation with the customer. Configuration of business software: workflows, rules, permissions, integrations. Working with finance teams: understanding the chart of accounts, closing processes and what has to reconcile. Running projects with multiple stakeholders: plan, risks, decisions, communication. Writing clear requirements for engineers and validating what they deliver. German and English; daily use of AI tools in project and data work. Useful additional experience Experience with SQL, scripting or low-code tools; integrations with banking, payroll or procurement systems; month-end and year-end close from the inside; consulting or customer-success experience with SaaS products. What early progress could look like In your first months, you would take over an onboarding in progress, bring it live inside the SLA and document the path. You would then own your next accounts from kick-off, build the migration and configuration playbook with engineering and hand the first clear requirements into the roadmap. We would look for customers live on time and reconciled, fewer issues after go-live, requirements that ship, and hours delivered inside what was sold. Operational excellence and customer commitments You take pride in customers who are live and whose numbers reconcile. When a go-live blocker, a failed migration or a month-end issue puts a customer deadline at risk, you take ownership, contain the impact, work with engineering on the fix and verify the result with the customer before treating it as resolved. Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an onboarding commitment or a financial deadline is at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed coverage. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover. How you will work This is a founding role in a small team. You report to the CEO and work daily with the Growth & Sales Managers who own the accounts, with the Head of Sales on what was sold, and with the engineering team on what the product can do. You will use AI tools in project, data and documentation work and remain responsible for the result. Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus. The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Travel to customer sites is part of the role. German is required. Start a conversation Share an implementation you ran. Tell us what the customer needed, how you handled the migration and the configuration, what went wrong, how you got to go-live and what you learned. A short written case or a walkthrough is enough.
